environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK action, (3) a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*and\s+')` with BLOCK action, and (4) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action (BLOCK). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs (com.amazonaws.region.logs), enforced by the task's security group which has NO outbound rules except to the VPC endpoint prefix list on port 443.

config.runtime: Python 3.11, Flask 2.3, gunicorn on ECS Fargate
